svg.title: Isotopes of chlorine
svg.desc: No tier label: isotopes are on both Edexcel International GCSE papers (4CH1 1.16; electronic configurations 1.19) and OxfordAQA International GCSE Chemistry is not tiered (9202 3.1.2g isotopes, 3.1.2i electronic structure). Two nuclei: chlorine-35 has 17 protons and 18 neutrons; chlorine-37 has 17 protons and 20 neutrons, so the mass number differs. Both atoms have the same 17 electrons arranged 2,8,7, so they have the same chemical properties.
